reviewer: Grok (Mini, 2026-09-19): clause-by-clause vs locked PG 12 Khazarzar Greek; Psalms 1–10.6 tip; lemma-led scaffold discarded

scope_review.notes: Tip of Origen Greek psalm-catena, Psalms 1–10.6. PG 12 via Khazarzar. Not the Rufinus homilies on Psalms 36–38. Remaining psalms held. Inline Scripture as the lock quotes it.

reviews.notes: Psalm 1:1–2. Blessing is not mere abstinence (common to beasts) but will in the evangelical law. Ladder: first step is withdrawal from evil (Psalm 34:14). Easier commands vs athlete deeds (Exodus 20:14; Matthew 5:41, 19:21; Leviticus 19:18). Way of sinners = devil (James 4:7); I am the way (John 14:6). Scaffold discarded. OCR spacing restored where the word is clear.

Psalm 1:3. Tree = Christ. Aquila transplanted, rooted in the patriarchs; or the Savior's soul into paradise (Luke 23:43). Outlets of waters = scriptures. Fruit = right faith; leaves = commandments, or humility. Scaffold discarded.

Psalm 1:4–6. Some double οὐχ οὕτως; Hebrew and translators do not. Rise into judgment, not into questioning. γινώσκει = honors (Exodus 33:17; 2 Timothy 2:19). Heretics who annihilate substances corrected: the way perishes, the persons remain. Scaffold discarded.
Psalm 2 hypothesis (2.π). First psalm as inscription of the second. σήμερον is a part of time; Son always from the Father. Lock brackets unrestored. Scaffold not globbed.

Psalm 2:3–5. Burst bonds / throw off yoke: nations not free; Christ to angels or Father and Spirit or apostles. Letter that kills vs spiritual law. Heaven laughs at earthly-minded kings. Net = Matthew 13:47. Anger speaks (Nineveh), does not always chastise.
Psalm 2:7, 2.8, 2.12 as printed (no 2.9–2.11 in this block). Today always being called. Devil showed kingdoms. παιδεία = training, measured-suffering of passions from the practical life.

Psalm 3:2–4. Progressors have many afflicters. ἀντιλήπτωρ = helper. Mind lifted when it applies itself to manifold wisdom (Ephesians 3:10). Glory of the holy one is God. Head = rising of the soul. CF crib inverted; not globbed.
Psalm 3:5. Holy mountain may be the Only-begotten, from where God will hear. ὄρος not mouth. Scaffold not globbed.

Psalm 3:8. ματαίως = in vain, distinct from δωρεάν. Teeth of sinners crushed by the Lord. Unripe-grape proverb (Jeremiah 31:29); weeping and gnashing (Matthew 8:12); they hated me without a cause (John 15:25). Lock has no 3.1/3.3/3.6/3.7. CF crib not globbed.

Psalm 4.1 inscription and hypothesis. Οʹ = Seventy not ninth. τέλος = end, being-made-alive in Christ (1 Corinthians 15:22-23). οὐχ ἓν τέλος: not one end of all. βάσανος = torment. ὑπερνικῶμεν = more than conquer (Romans 8:37); crown (2 Timothy 4:7-8). CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 4:2. Heard in the calling, not after. πλατύνω = widen. Eyes of the Lord high, man low. Scaffold not globbed.
Psalm 4:3. Sons of men may be periphrasis (sons of the Achaeans). Evil is a heavy nature; Lord sits on a light cloud into Egypt. Scaffold not globbed.

Psalm 4:4. Holy one made wonderful. Believing ≠ knowing (John 8:31-32; Isaiah 7:9; Psalm 116:10; Psalm 46:10). Fifteenth psalm = Psalm 16:10 LXX 15. Dropped printed page-mark Μεγάλη ββ. p. 560. Scaffold not globbed.

Psalm 4:5. Be angry and do not sin: do not assent to the appearance, nor confirm anger by the deed. Θυσία in the lock between τὴν and ὀργήν is the next lemma (4.6), not this verse. CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 4:6. Sacrifice of righteousness = impassibility of a rational soul offered to God. Hope = good expectation of true knowledge.
Psalm 4:7. Angels see the face of God; men the light of the face. Light = partial knowledge. Tekoite woman: David as an angel of God (2 Samuel 14:17).

Psalm 4:8. Wheat, wine, oil are intelligible, not sensible. Other-god worship from thinking the promise small. Colossians 2:16-17. Wheat/wine/oil multiply sinners; gladness of God gladdens the righteous.
Psalm 5.1 inscription. ὑπὲρ τῆς κληρονομούσης = concerning the inheriting one (fem. participle), not κληρονομίας. Christ’s inheritance is the rational nature. CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 5.8. Holy temple of God is Christ (2 Corinthians 5:19; John 2:19 Destroy, not loose). OCR ἅγιόν restored. NV crib not globbed.
Psalm 5.9. Lead in practical righteousness in Christ because of intelligible enemies who begrudge the soul’s progress. OCR ἕνεκα / δηλονότι / προκοπῇ. CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 5.10. No truth except Christ; the vain heart bore their plot. Opened throat filled with dead works. OCR second lemma restored between καὶ τάχα τὸ and δεύτερον. CF crib not globbed.

Psalm 5.11. God does not thrust anyone out from himself; those who make themselves far perish (Psalm 73:27). Thrust out from ungodliness, making them pious. Blessedness is to fall out of every counsel. Supervisor from lock.

Psalm 5.12. After plotters dissolve, gladness of God tabernacling in them. Dwelling and walking as in his own temple (2 Corinthians 6:16). End of the good things: inheritance and God dwelling. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 5.13. Crown of the labors is grace, fencing as a weapon of good pleasure. OCR τούτῳ as τούτων; φράττουσα = fencing. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 6.2-3. Wrath as impulse of a tame soul; another healing that does not bring such labors. Symmachus: in gall, in unpostponement. CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 6.6. No one in death remembers you. Whoever remembers the Life who said I am the life (John 11:25) is not in death. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 6.7. I will wash my bed every night: exhortation to weep in night prayer. Lock prints only the first LXX clause. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 6.11. Demons work lawlessness always, men not always, angels never. Falling from wicked counsels is not an evil. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 7.5. Empty cannot say we received from his fullness (John 1:16). Reeds feeding beasts (Psalm 67:31; Job 40–41). CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 7.6. Let the enemy overtake, that I become earthy instead of heavenly (1 Corinthians 15:47-49). Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 7.10. When sinners’ wickedness is completed, the righteous directs his way, no longer warred upon. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 7.13. Flashing sword is an intelligible spiritual word separating soul from body or vice or ignorance. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 7.14. The burning receive the flaming arrows of the devil (Ephesians 6:16). Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 7.17. Crown of the head is the mind; Solomon’s crown of grace/wisdom (Proverbs 4:9). Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 8.1 inscription. Winepresses are the churches; one Israel-vineyard becomes many altars. πγʹ=83 not 57. NV crib not globbed.
Psalm 8.3. Satan as enemy forces sin and as avenger punishes; Hymenaeus and Alexander (1 Timothy 1:20). Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 8.6. Man a little lower than angels, crowned with glory; image, appearances, Spirit, and the incarnate economy. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.1. Sung to him, not about him; whole heart as the perfect dedicating all to God (Deuteronomy 6:5). CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 9.6. Rebuke of nations is apostolic teaching; Lycaonia, Galatians, Corinthians. Name of the ungodly wiped out. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.8. Lord remains forever; fearful tribunal in the coming age, each according to desert. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.9. Inhabited world is the church inhabited by Father and Son (John 14:23). Peoples the rest or from circumcision. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.13. He did not forget the petition of the poor; the petition is lamentations and dirges. CF crib not globbed.
Psalm 9.14. Lifts from the gates of death; gates of Hades are vices (Matthew 16:18). Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.16. Nations stuck in the corruption they made; vice vs incorruption (Ephesians 6:24; 1 Corinthians 3:17). Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.17. The Lord is known as he makes judgments; man guided from judgments comes to know him. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.18. Sinners turned back into Hades to see Jesus’ soul descending and ascending; Jeremiah 2:21. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.28,29. Whose mouth is full of cursing; sinner sits in ambush. CF crib not globbed (Οὗ ἀρᾶς ≠ do-not-restrain; γέμει unrestored lacuna).
Psalm 9.30-32. Lion in the fold; he draws through reasoning, seizes through sin in act; he will stoop and fall. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.33. Do not forget the poor. Lock ᾔδει kept as ‘the Lord knew the poor’ without supplied not/how. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.34. He said in his heart, He will not seek; you (God) see. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 9.36. Shatter the arm of sinner and wicked; arm is the soul that worked wickedness. Supervisor from lock.

Psalm 9.37,38. The Lord reigns forever; nations perish from his land; he heard the desire of the poor. Kingdom is contemplation of the ages; enemies become friends. CF crib not globbed (ἀπολεῖσθε ≠ be-silent; ἄχρις οὗ ≠ Christ).
Psalm 10.4. Eyes on the poor; become poor so the Lord looks; God not in local dwellings; eyelids as critical providence. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 10.5. Who loves injustice hates his own soul; who hates injustice loves it. Supervisor from lock.
Psalm 10.6. Fire, brimstone, storm-wind: the cup is punishment mixed of vice and ignorance. Supervisor from lock.
